decisions.reason: The coffee men's care line extends the firm's established offer into a new segment. Its prospects are still uncertain, since there is no evidence after 2019, and the line shares existing production, so keeping the option open costs little. Men's lines from small natural-cosmetics firms are, however, more likely to be pruned than core products.

The cleansing foam adds to the established Sandorini series and uses existing formulas and channels. Its holding cost is minimal, and nothing in the evidence shows that its value will not be realized, so dropping it now is not justified.
